title: lightdni-jssas-toggle
description: LightDNI (Doesn't Need Integration) provides a simple declarative API for adding a theme toggle to your website.

content.heading: lightdni-jssas-toggle
content: LightDNI (Doesn't Need Integration) provides a simple declarative API for adding a theme toggle to your website.

content.heading: From the README
content: TypeScript utility package for applying and toggling CSS themes: theme classes and attributes on the root element, dynamic CSS variables, localStorage/cookie persistence, and accessibility metadata (color-scheme and aria-live announcements).
A consolidated one-call setTheme API - dependency-safe, and works in vanilla JS/TS, React, and Vue projects.
